source: Source-informed VPM redesign of cache orchestration, compilation storage and hydration. Upstream sources and tests were inspected; this is not a clean-room claim. Existing compatibility plugins, prefix rules, diagnostic wording and declarations retain the upstream contract and attribution.
changes: Cache construction, StyleCompiler and hydration are separate components. Browser insertions own their output destination; compiled CSS uses full selector/styles keys, bounded maps and per-cache custom-plugin storage. Dependencies are vemotion-sheet, vemotion-utils (declarations) and vstylis.
compat splits selectors with its own scanner instead of stylis's module-global tokenizer.

The prefixer selects properties by name with Emotion's rule set (stylis's rules without grid prefixing): the original's copy of stylis 4.0.13's prefixer selected them by a hash of the name's length and first four characters, so properties sharing a hash got invented declarations (flex-wrap gained -webkit-box-flex-wrap, color-scheme -webkit-print-color-scheme).
align-self gives IE's -ms-flex-item-align a valid keyword (the original wrote flex-start), and justify-content: space-between keeps -ms-flex-pack:justify (the original's pattern removed it).
The prefixer is exported for combining with other plugins.
The #is-development and #is-browser conditions choose development or production and browser or server behavior, as in the original's conditional builds.

verification.upstreamSuite: Complete fixture on Node 24: React 16 development 413 pass, 2 existing Babel-plugin differences, 8 skipped; React 18 development 416 pass, the same 2 differences, 5 skipped; production 5 pass and 418 skipped.
verification.differential: compare-cache.cjs: 10,000 generated styles in each of four configurations, both development and production, on Node 24 and Bun. Exact CSS/state and distinct warning text match @emotion/cache 11.14.0 on stylis 4.4.0. Development warning repetitions intentionally differ across isolated caches and are reported separately.
verification.declarations: types.cjs compiles an application against the declarations with DOM types under the configured TypeScript 7 compiler.
verification.regressions: Seven focused tests, including full-source cache keys, bounded storage, custom-plugin request isolation, prototype names, nested insertion destinations and cross-document hydration; original-control browser cases reproduce both upstream defects.
verification.application: styled-consumer.cjs: ten identical MUI system 7.2.0 / React 19.1.0 HTML/CSS renders against upstream, on Node 24 and Bun.
verification.benchmark: bench/compare.cjs uses one selected implementation per worker, balanced order and identical-source controls. Cache construction and server compilation are measured separately from the vemotion-styled full-stack caller benchmark.

implementation.basis: Replaces a close translation of createCache with per-invocation emission, bounded compilation storage and document-scoped hydration. Prefix rules and compatibility plugins remain source-informed and attributed.
implementation.scope: VentiMath RootThemeProvider LTR/RTL and @layer plugins, MUI cache/sheet integration, server rendering, legacy compat rendering and hydration.
retainedComponents: src/plugins.js: Emotion compatibility behavior, with an existing independent selector scanner
src/prefixer.js: property-name dispatch for Emotion prefix rules
